technology_name: QUATERNARY BLENDED ENGINEERED GEOPOLYMER COMPOSITE (EGC) PAVER BLOCKS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Green Construction Materials / Paver Block Synthesis
problem_solved: Standard concrete interlocking paver blocks fracture easily under recurring heavy vehicle shear stresses and consume non-renewable natural resources during baseline assembly.
description: A durable, carbon-neutral quaternary blended Engineered Geopolymer Composite (EGC) composition combining precise concentrations of dynamic industrial by-products activated via Potassium Hydroxide ($KOH$) and Potassium Silicate ($K_2SiO_3$) solutions, further reinforced with specialized discrete fibers.
applications: Heavy-duty industrial port paving, urban smart city pedestrian walkways, sustainable municipal road intersections, and eco-friendly parking deck surfaces.
